source_conversation.content: I have an iPhone 15 and need to scan a signed form into a note in the Notes app. What do I tap?

candidates.decision_basis: The user states iPhone and the Notes app, and the Apple page gives the Notes scanning steps for iPhone, so an answer is allowed.
candidates.target:
Here is how to scan a form into a note on your iPhone.
1. Open **Notes** and select a note, or create a new one.
2. Tap the **Attachment button**, then tap **Scan Documents**.
3. Position the document in front of the camera. If your device is in Auto mode, your document will automatically scan. Otherwise, tap the **Shutter button** or press a Volume button.
4. Drag the corners to adjust the scan to fit the page, then tap **Keep Scan**.
5. Tap the **Done button**, or add more scans to the document.
In iOS 26, you can also select options such as flash or an image filter. Alternatively, in an open note, tap the **More button**, then tap **Scan**.
candidates.author_note: Cover Notes steps: open or create note, Attachment button, Scan Documents, camera positioning, Auto mode condition, Shutter button or Volume button otherwise, Keep Scan, Done or add more scans. iOS 26 options and the More button alternative are conditions from the page. No source gap for iPhone; iOS 17 and earlier not covered.
